frequency_question: How often do threatened major tariffs against close economic partners proceed to full implementation rather than being averted or delayed by negotiated deals within the policy window?
membership_rule: Includes explicit executive threats of sectoral or broad tariffs exceeding 20% against G7 or USMCA trade partners where implementation deadlines were set within 12 months; excludes routine antidumping duties, standard congressional trade enforcement, and unthreatened baseline tariffs.
